model_family: Fixed-spacing SU(2) Kogut-Susskind on Z^3 with 24-link coarse factors, zero selected triple unless stated, 21 omitted anchored face classes per factor with coefficient alpha*tau/24 grouped into whole stars (I1.5), |tau|<=1e-8, AQ subsequential thermodynamic state, physical clock s=alpha t_E/hbar.

parameter_classification.name: tau
parameter_classification.note: both signs; changing it is a model change, not a tolerance

parameter_classification.name: theta_w (polymer size weight base), R=1/64 (ball radius)

goal_pairs.title: Second-order local state expansion with explicit constants from the AM2 creation fixed point
goal_pairs.model: AM2 finite complete-factor volumes, zero selected triple, both signs of tau, |tau|<=1e-8; passage to the AQ state by local trace-norm convergence.
goal_pairs.observable: omega_tau(X) for X in B(H_R), R={0,e_z}; specifically omega_tau(W) and omega_tau(W^2)-1/4; deliverables: exact rational c_1 (candidate 2368) and K_2 in |omega_tau(X)-omega_0(X)-tau x_1(X)| <= K_2 tau^2 ||X||, with x_1(W)=1/144 and x_1(W^2)=0.
goal_pairs.control: tau=0 exactness; sign flip tau->-tau; a toy fixture where sign-changing weights break the monotonicity Z_{a u a'}<=Z; a deliberately non-star-connected coefficient collection must be rejected; weighted-norm fixed point must close for theta_w in {2,3,4} and be reported failing at theta_w=8.
expected_outcome_types: limited (O(tau) proved, K_2 only with overcounted constant)
goal_pairs.why: Removes the square-root bottleneck (34x at leading order) and is the premise of AW and AX; the six unproved steps A1-A6 are enumerated in memo 5.1.

goal_pairs.title: Cap-level Euclidean node by the vanishing-first-order plus second-order Duhamel route
goal_pairs.model: AQ zero-selected subfamily, tau=+1e-8, s=1, original centered xz Wilson, original physical clock; second Duhamel step over the 40 stars meeting R^+ (20 sites).
goal_pairs.observable: C(1)=<chi,e^{-H/alpha}chi> with absolute target 1e-6 (preview budget 2.0e-7 at L*=3.4e6 under crude constants).
goal_pairs.control: An observable with nonvanishing first-order dynamical term (e.g. W times an adjacent face operator) must recover the 1.27e-6 first-order floor; missing stars and wrong clock rejected; s=0 handled separately by the variance; full Poisson tail retained; both signs of tau.
goal_pairs.why: Observation 2's floor is a first-order artifact; the first-order terms vanish identically by SU(2) Peter-Weyl orthogonality, so the cap target needs no renegotiation if AV supplies K_2.

goal_pairs.title: Sign of the Wilson mean omega_tau(W)=tau/144+O(tau^2): a resolved interaction-induced effect
goal_pairs.model: Same AQ family; tau chosen as the largest |tau|<=1e-8 for which the proved K_2 satisfies K_2|tau|<1/144 (crude constants: |tau|<=4e-11).
goal_pairs.observable: Enclosure [tau/144-K_2 tau^2, tau/144+K_2 tau^2] for omega_tau(W), excluding the free value 0, at +tau and -tau.
goal_pairs.control: Mirror symmetry of the two enclosures to O(tau^2); the correlation enclosures at +/-tau must coincide to O(tau^2); removing W's own face class from phi_0 must set the first-order coefficient to zero; the Haar integrals verified exactly (sympy), Monte Carlo as preview only.
expected_outcome_types: accepted_within_scope (sign certified at the declared tau)
limited (sign certified only below the cap)
insufficient (K_2 too large at every tau in scope)
goal_pairs.why: The correlation shift is second order (~1e-16 at the cap) and unresolvable; the mean is the only first-order effect and directly meets roadmap goal 2's 'exclude the matched free reference'.

goal_pairs.title: Uniform magnetic Hamiltonian: exact incidence, non-Haar reference to second order, AM2 re-check
goal_pairs.model: Selected triple set to the uniform value alpha*tau/24 for the three selected xy faces per factor (inside the admitted box), omitted classes unchanged.
goal_pairs.observable: Derivation deliverables: incidence count (6 selected faces meet R; reset budget 102|tau|, epsilon_R<=17|tau|), the on-site reference ground state and the W-excitation energy to second order in tau, and whether the first-order vanishing identities for W-observables persist.
goal_pairs.control: tau=0 reduces to Haar; the AL1 dictionary tau=96/g^4 reproduced; a deliberately dropped selected face changes the incidence count and must be detected.
goal_pairs.why: Roadmap goal 3 requires the reference and budgets to be re-derived before any transfer; AM2 already includes selected potentials in h_x, so the gap part is a re-check, not new proof.

goal_pairs.title: Exact finite-graph second-order coefficients at moderate tau (a different finite model)
goal_pairs.model: A finite plaquette graph (two xz plaquettes sharing a link, then a single cube) with representation cutoff j_max and a certified tail, at tau in [1e-3, 1]; exact rational/interval linear algebra with Arb cross-check.
goal_pairs.observable: d<W>/dtau at tau=0 (must equal 1/144 in the matched normalization), the second-order coefficients of <W> and of the centered correlation, and their comparison with the AV constant K_2.
goal_pairs.control: Cutoff convergence with certified tail; tau->-tau symmetry checks; the free-graph limit reproduces e^{-3s}/4; labelled as a finite model, never as AQ data.
goal_pairs.why: Observation 3 route (a): measures what the second-order constants actually are in a computable model, guiding the sharpening of K_2 by >=250x needed at the cap.

strategy_changes: Re-target roadmap goal 2 from the correlation shift (second order, unresolvable at the cap) to the Wilson mean (first order, coefficient 1/144).

Before charging any first-order Duhamel or state budget, compute the first-order coefficient exactly; if it vanishes by representation theory, freeze a second-order contract instead of renegotiating the target.
Treat the AM2 creation expansion as a polymer expansion with nonnegative sector weights; handle normalization by the monotonicity Z_{a u a'} <= Z rather than by any adjoint or inverse of e^{-C}.
Prefer the creation route over the spectral-flow route for explicit constants (2368 vs ~2.9e6); keep the spectral flow as an independent cross-check only.
Keep the failed AT4 cap certificate and the first-order floor 1.265e-6 visible as retained outcomes in every AW report.

disagreements: With the brief's framing of observation 2 (sharper real-time comparison OR Euclidean argument OR renegotiated target): the first-order real-time term vanishes exactly, so the second-order Duhamel is the sharper comparison and no renegotiation is needed if AV's K_2 is proved; the Euclidean-side second-order route was examined and set aside (imaginary-time evolution of the excitation cloud costs e^{27 s}).
With roadmap goal 2 as stated: an interacting enclosure of the correlation excluding the free reference is not attainable at the cap by any O(tau^2)-error method; the mean is the honest target.

With any reliance on Yarotsky/HTW/spectral-flow constants for the cap: their constants are existential or (BMNS) about 1.5e4/gamma; the model-specific creation route is the only one with usable explicit constants.
Occult and alchemical sources: none yields a model, observable and control beyond workflow analogy; they stay in the interpretation column.
